en:sendNotice.compactNeedsSession.text: Nothing to compact yet: this chat's engine session is being rebuilt from the conversation. Send a message first, then try /compact again.
en:sendNotice.compactNeedsSession.en: Nothing to compact yet: this chat's engine session is being rebuilt from the conversation. Send a message first, then try /compact again.
en:sendNotice.compactNeedsSession.note: Clear and calm; it says why, what to do, and keeps /compact literal, matching the source in send-notice.ts.

en:sendNotice.commandNeedsSession.text: That command runs on the engine's current session, which is being rebuilt. Send a message first, then try it again.
en:sendNotice.commandNeedsSession.en: That command runs on the engine's current session, which is being rebuilt. Send a message first, then try it again.
en:sendNotice.commandNeedsSession.note: Accurate and gives a plain next step that matches the compact variant.

en:sendNotice.commandModelChanged.text: The model for this conversation changed. Send a message first, then run the command again.
en:sendNotice.commandModelChanged.en: The model for this conversation changed. Send a message first, then run the command again.
en:sendNotice.commandModelChanged.note: Short and plain, with the same 'Send a message first' step as its siblings.

de:sendNotice.compactNeedsSession.text: Noch nichts zu komprimieren: Die Engine-Sitzung dieses Chats wird gerade aus der Unterhaltung neu aufgebaut. Sende zuerst eine Nachricht und versuche /compact dann erneut.
de:sendNotice.compactNeedsSession.en: Nothing to compact yet: this chat's engine session is being rebuilt from the conversation. Send a message first, then try /compact again.
de:sendNotice.compactNeedsSession.note: Accurate, uses informal du like the other de sendNotice strings, 'Engine-Sitzung' matches de term use, and /compact stays literal.

de:sendNotice.commandNeedsSession.text: Dieser Befehl läuft in der aktuellen Sitzung der Engine, die gerade neu aufgebaut wird. Sende zuerst eine Nachricht und versuche es dann erneut.
de:sendNotice.commandNeedsSession.en: That command runs on the engine's current session, which is being rebuilt. Send a message first, then try it again.
de:sendNotice.commandNeedsSession.note: Accurate and natural, with du-form imperatives and 'erneut' consistent with the sibling strings.

de:sendNotice.commandModelChanged.text: Das Modell für diese Unterhaltung hat sich geändert. Sende zuerst eine Nachricht und führe den Befehl dann erneut aus.

de:sendNotice.commandModelChanged.note: Accurate and natural; 'führe den Befehl dann erneut aus' reads well in the du register.

es:sendNotice.commandNeedsSession.text: Ese comando se ejecuta en la sesión actual del motor, que se está reconstruyendo. Envía primero un mensaje y luego vuelve a intentarlo.

es:sendNotice.commandNeedsSession.note: Accurate and natural; 'vuelve a intentarlo' fits the locale's tone.

ja:sendNotice.compactNeedsSession.text: まだ圧縮できる内容がありません。このチャットのエンジンセッションは会話から再構築中です。先にメッセージを送信してから、もう一度 /compact をお試しください。

ja:sendNotice.commandNeedsSession.text: このコマンドはエンジンの現在のセッションで実行されますが、そのセッションは再構築中です。先にメッセージを送信してから、もう一度お試しください。

ja:sendNotice.commandNeedsSession.note: Accurate and natural; the ～ますが、そのセッションは clause carries the 'which is being rebuilt' meaning clearly.
